cohort: Mothers with preterm labor at 34 to 36 weeks of pregnancy and their newborns, recruited from Mahdieh Hospital in Tehran, Iran.
finding: A full course of betamethasone in mothers with preterm labor at 34-36 weeks of pregnancy had no significant impact on pregnancy outcomes for the mother and fetus.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the rates of cesarean or vaginal deliveries between the intervention and control groups.
